name: entry_balances_per_currency
statement: Every journal entry sums to zero per transaction currency and in company currency; its group amounts are either all null or sum to zero.

name: trial_balance_zero
statement: Per company and posting period, company amounts of all lines sum to zero, and group amounts are all null or sum to zero.

name: amount_at_minor_unit
statement: Every stored amount has no more decimal places than its currency's minor unit.

name: rounding_line_bounded
statement: An entry has at most one line with a rounding key; it has transaction amount 0, posts to the account mapped to rounding_gain or rounding_loss, and in each currency is at most half a minor unit times the entry's line count.

name: system_account_matches_mapping
statement: Every line's system_account_id equals the mapping of its operational account.

name: balance_cache_equals_lines
statement: The period balance cache equals the sum of the journal lines it summarizes.

name: numbers_without_gaps
flagged: ADR-0009 rule 8: numbering of non-posting documents at approval
statement: Per numbering_series, the counters of all documents that hold a number, in any state, are exactly 1 to next_value minus 1, each once.

name: posted_documents_unchanged
statement: The fingerprint of every posted document (its header without state, its versions, journal entries and lines, material lines) equals the fingerprint recorded when the harness first saw it posted; state may change only from posted to reversed.

name: reversal_nets_to_zero
flagged: ADR-0009 rule 20: storno or swapped sides
statement: An original and its reversal net to zero per account, dimension set and currency.

name: version_content_matches_rows
statement: The current document version's content and version_hash equal those computed from the typed rows.

name: retry_returns_identical_response
statement: A command retried with the same idempotency key returns the stored response, identical except for replayed, and the company's business-table fingerprints (DS-16 rule 9) are the same before and after the retry.

name: executed_equals_simulated
statement: Executing a command with the plan_hash of its simulation succeeds and produces the simulated plan.

name: deliveries_complete_once
statement: Every outbox event has exactly one event_delivery per subscribed consumer, and after the harness drains the queues none is pending, running or held (applied-once is PAR-04).

name: postings_respect_period_state
statement: A posting into a locked period, or into a soft-locked period without the capability, is rejected and writes nothing; one into an open period is not rejected for its period.

name: responses_within_field_classes
statement: No response, plan, delivered event or error detail holds a field of a field class the actor lacks.

name: line_passes_key_cross_check
statement: Every journal line with a transaction key posts to an account whose system account is among the key's required system accounts and control kind.

name: approvals_human_and_segregated
statement: Every approval was made by a human, and no approved document has a version whose agent_run_id or origin_agent_run_id belongs to a run on behalf of the approver.

name: events_match_simulation
statement: The event types an executed command emitted equal those its simulation listed.

name: event_outcome_as_expected
statement: Each event's outcome matches its outcome class: must_succeed succeeded; must_reject failed with its code; may_reject succeeded or failed with one of its allowed codes.

name: inventory_accounts_equal_valuation
statement: The balance of every account with control kind inventory equals the stock valuation report for that account, per warehouse.

name: no_negative_stock
flagged: ADR-0020 rule 10: negative-stock time point
statement: No closing quantity per item, warehouse and lot or serial is negative at the end of any date.

name: serial_at_most_one
statement: No serial number has more than one unit on hand on any date.

name: material_lines_equal_journal
statement: Every material document line's company_amount equals the journal lines that refer to it.

name: stock_tables_equal_movements
statement: stock_quantity equals the sum of material line quantities, and stock_value the sum of inventory journal amounts, per their keys.

name: transfer_value_conserved
statement: On every transfer document, the value received equals the value issued per item.

name: allocations_sum_to_cost
statement: Landed cost allocations sum exactly to each cost line, and every allocation and costing adjustment has a derivation trace.

name: clearing_equals_unallocated
statement: No source line on purchase_cost_clearing is allocated beyond its amount, and per source line the clearing balance equals its unallocated rest.

name: inventory_lines_carry_item
statement: Every line on an inventory account carries item and warehouse, and a material document line when its document has a material document.

name: stock_reversal_returns_quantities
statement: A reversed stock document's reversal lines return exactly the original quantities per item, warehouse and lot, with is_reversal true.

name: open_items_equal_control_accounts
statement: Every receivable or payable control account equals the sum of its open items, per partner and currency.

name: control_lines_carry_open_item
statement: Every line on a receivable or payable account carries a partner and an open item.

name: carrying_amount_consistent
statement: An open item's company-currency carrying amount equals its original amount plus its revaluations and realized differences.

name: open_item_cache_equals_lines
statement: Each open item's cached open and revaluation amounts equal the sums of its journal lines in transaction, company and group currency; a settled item has all open amounts zero.

name: open_item_not_against_side
statement: No open item's open transaction amount has the sign opposite to its natural side.

name: line_matches_open_item
statement: Every journal line that refers to an open item has the item's company, partner, account and transaction currency.

name: successor_equals_predecessor
statement: A moved item's original amounts equal its predecessor's open amounts excluding revaluation, and its revaluation amounts equal its predecessor's, at the move, in all three currencies.

name: gr_ir_per_order_line
flagged: ADR-0030 rule 4: invoice-first valuation
statement: Every journal line on a gr_ir account whose document line refers to a purchase order line has purchase_order_line_id; per purchase order line whose received quantity equals its invoiced quantity, net of returns and credit notes, the GR/IR balance in transaction currency is zero.

name: corrections_within_original
statement: Cumulative corrections never exceed the original: returned per delivery line within delivered, credited quantity per invoice line within invoiced, credited amount within the line's net amount, and the same for purchase lines (ADR-0047 rule 20).

name: referenced_lines_live
statement: Every line referred to by an open demand_supply_line row, or by a line of a document that is not canceled or reversed, belongs to a document that is not canceled.

name: accepted_e_invoice_posted
statement: Every accepted e-invoice has a posted document, or an open work item while its posting is held.

name: single_pending_change
statement: pending_version is null exactly when change_state is none, and otherwise is greater than version.

name: issuing_writes_nothing
statement: A document in issuing has no journal entry, document number or open item.

name: quantity_not_below_fulfilled
statement: No document line's quantity is below the quantity fulfilled by referring documents.

name: posted_e_invoiced_has_acceptance
flagged: ADR-0028 rule 13: e-invoice posting model
statement: Every posted document with a posting_intent recording that the e-invoice was required has an accepted e-invoice.

name: execution_on_version_in_force
statement: Open reservations and unstarted warehouse tasks refer only to open demand_supply_line rows.

name: material_line_posting_date
statement: Every material_document_line.posting_date equals the posting date of its posting document.

name: document_partner_matches_header
statement: For every document type with a partner field, the shared document row's partner_id and document_date equal the typed header's values; types without one have both empty.

name: warehouse_movements_net_zero
statement: Warehouse movements net to zero per item, warehouse and lot or serial.

name: stock_rows_equal_movements
statement: stock_quantity per full key equals its material lines plus warehouse movements.

name: no_negative_current_stock
statement: No current stock_quantity per full key is negative.

name: handling_unit_in_one_bin
statement: A handling unit, its stock rows and its children are in one warehouse and bin.

name: reservations_within_available
flagged: ADR-0023 rule 13: no overbooking
statement: Open and picked reservations never exceed the available-status quantity per item and warehouse.

name: confirmed_task_equals_movements
statement: Every confirmed putaway, pick, replenishment, move or status-change task has movements equal to its confirmed quantity; every movement names its task or its writing command.

name: bins_match_warehouse_mode
statement: Every stock row has a bin of its own warehouse, and a warehouse that is not bin-managed has exactly one bin, its default_bin_id.

name: reservations_match_demand
statement: Per demand line, the reserved amounts of open and picked reservations never exceed the line's open quantity.

name: reservation_quantities_match_execution
statement: Per demand line, the reservations' picked quantities equal the confirmed pick-task quantities, and their fulfilled quantities equal the posted delivery, production issue and backflush quantities for that line.

name: pegging_sums_to_quantity
statement: Every proposed or firmed planned order has pegging rows that sum exactly to its quantity.

name: planning_run_reproducible
statement: Two simulated planning runs at a check point give equal output_hash, and a stored run with the same input_hash has that output_hash; not_evaluated from erpme-check.

name: converted_order_keeps_origin
statement: Every document line created from a converted planned order carries its origin_planned_order_id, and every converted planned order has such a line or is canceled.

name: demand_supply_matches_source
statement: Each demand_supply_line open quantity equals its source line's quantity minus fulfilled and closed quantities, recomputed from the referring documents.

name: active_subledger_dimensions_present
statement: Every line on an account whose control kind is active for the company on its posting date carries that kind's dimensions, except the undimensioned lines of the subledger_reclassification document; no line before an activation date is posted after activation; and no line refers to another company's cost object or fixed asset.

name: tainted_never_acts
source: spec 03 rule 1; ADR-0013 rule 11; ADR-0027 rule 17
statement: No tainted outbox event whose command has effect class posting, master_data_change or outbound_send has a non-human actor.

name: human_only_never_by_agent
flagged: ADR-0008 rule 2: may integrations execute human_only commands
statement: No audit row of a command registered human_only has actor kind agent, or integration while the interim holds.

name: required_approval_present
flagged: ADR-0009 rule 12: approval required treated as human-only posting
source: ADR-0009 rules 11, 12; ADR-0027 rule 17; ADR-0028 rule 14; ADR-0043 rules 2, 19
statement: For every posted document whose policy decision on the posted version requires a rank, every stage of the approval plan of the decision its Post used (for an e-invoiced document, the decision of its Issue) has at least its required number of counted approved approvals on that version within the round that Post or Issue ended (ADR-0055 rules 8, 18); documents whose outcome is human_only are excluded.

name: attachment_links_resolve
statement: Every attachment_link points to an existing row of its target table within the attachment's company.

name: tainted_never_auto_allowed
flagged: ADR-0029 rule 8: taint clearing
statement: No policy decision with outcome allowed for a non-human actor concerns a document version (change proposals included) that was effectively tainted at the time of the decision.

name: agent_consumers_never_post
statement: No audit row with actor system and an origin agent run has effect class posting or master_data_change.

name: proposal_targets_never_by_agent
statement: No audit row of a command whose effect class is master_data_change or that is registered is_proposal_bound has actor agent or an origin agent run.

name: auto_posts_confirmed_before_lock
statement: Every posting by actor system or integration whose policy decision has is_confirmation_required, in a locked period, has an auto_post_confirmation row.

name: taint_inherited
flagged: ADR-0029 rule 8: taint clearing
statement: Every document version written by a run tainted at its recorded_at, or whose origin run was, or whose previous or derived_from_version_id version was effectively tainted when it was written, has is_tainted true.

name: executed_commands_audited
statement: Every idempotency record of an executed command, within its retention, has an audit record with the same key, actor and command type, or the same batch_id for a batch; company_id is compared null-safely.

name: sales_delivered_within_ordered
statement: Per sales order line, delivered net of returns never exceeds the ordered quantity.

name: sales_invoiced_within_delivered
statement: Per stock sales order line, invoiced net of quantity credits never exceeds delivered net of returns, unless an open sales_return_due work item names the line. Purchase lines may be invoiced before receipt (ADR-0047 rule 14).

name: gr_ir_equals_rounded_positions
statement: Per purchase order line, the GR/IR balance in the order's currency equals round(V(I)) - round(V(R)) at the line's position layers, V being the exact value of positions up to a quantity and rounding to the currency's minor unit; it is zero when received net equals invoiced net.

name: price_steps_reproduce_price
statement: Every commercial document line's price steps reproduce its net unit price and its line amount.

name: money_account_floor_and_sweep
statement: The balance of every money account without overdraft, in its currency and posting-date order, is never negative at any date; a money account whose foreign balance is zero has zero company and group balances.

name: matched_bank_line_has_document
statement: Every matched bank statement line refers to a posted, unreversed document of the same money account whose amount on that money account equals the line's.

name: bank_statement_chain
statement: Each bank statement's opening balance equals the previous statement's closing balance, or the statement has has_gap; opening plus lines equals closing.

name: evidence_on_listed_lines
statement: Every journal line with an open item that is not the item's origin line, has a non-zero transaction amount and is not the reversal of an origin line, and every origin line of an advance or payment-on-account item, has an evidence_method; no other line has one.

name: bom_acyclic_low_level_codes
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: No cycle exists through released production bills of materials, counting outputs as children and a configurable product as the node of its configured items; every component's and output's low-level code is greater than each parent's, and a configured item's equals its product's.

name: structure_content_hash_matches
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Every released bill of materials and routing revision's content_hash equals the hash of its stored rows.

name: production_version_covered
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: At every date of an active production version's range, its active bill of materials and, if set, its active routing each have a valid released revision.

name: production_lines_carry_cost_object
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Every material line of a production document carries its order's cost_object_id.

name: receipts_within_tolerance
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Per production order other than disassembly, cumulative net receipts of the main output never exceed G × (1 + overdelivery_tolerance_percent / 100).

name: as_built_serial_assigned
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Every output_serial_number_id on a production issue line is a serial assigned to an output of the same order.

name: wip_matches_period_cost
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: After the costing job, each order's inventory_work_in_process balance equals the closing amounts of its latest production_order_period_cost, and a technically complete order's is zero.

name: cost_pools_cleared
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: After the costing job, each cost_pool cost object's balance on the production leaves is zero for the period.

name: production_receipts_recomputed
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: The naive recomputation, extended with cost-object nodes, reproduces every production receipt's value.

name: planned_components_match_function
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Each proposed, frozen or firmed planned production order's planned_order_component rows equal plan_production at its stored version, dates and quantity.

name: converted_planned_order_inert
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: A converted production planned order contributes no supply or dependent demand to the latest run.

name: processor_movements_allowed
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Every material line at a processor location has one of the movement types ADR-0037 rule 1 allows there.

name: backflush_lines_match_order
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Every operation_progress_component line refers to a component line of the same production order as its calling document and to a material line of that document with movement type production_issue; for a service receipt that material line is at the order's processor location.

name: configured_lines_complete
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Every non-draft line of a configurable product on a document of an is_item_creating type, and every stock document line of one, names a complete configuration and an item whose variant values equal the configuration's item-defining values; a non-draft quotation line names a complete configuration, and an item only when one with those values exists.

name: configuration_hash_matches
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Every product_configuration's content_hash equals the hash of its stored values.

name: structure_conditions_item_defining
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Every component and operation condition and sizing of a product-level structure names only item-defining characteristics of its product.

name: policy_rule_set_monotonic
statement: The enabled policy rule set of each company passes the save-time monotonicity check for every future effective date.

name: non_human_allowing_rules_bounded
statement: Every enabled policy rule that allows a non-human actor to post or issue has an owner, confirmation and a maximum amount.

name: one_approval_item_per_pending_document
statement: Every document in pending_approval has exactly one open approval_pending work item.

name: no_agent_work_after_takeover
statement: No command of an agent run bound to a work item is audited after a person claimed that item.

name: tainted_run_outputs_tainted
source: ADR-0050 rules 25-26; ADR-0013 rule 11; ADR-0042 rule 5
statement: Every outbox event, work item raise and work item note written by an agent run tainted at the row's recorded_at (tainted_at at or before it, the instant INV-88 uses), or by a consumer whose origin run was tainted at the origin event's recorded_at, has is_tainted true.

name: agent_commands_on_tool_list
statement: Every audit record with an agent_run_id names a command on the tool list of that run's agent type version.

name: agent_spend_within_budget
statement: Every ended agent run's totals are within its budget snapshot and its reservations are zero; every agent_budget_usage row's spent plus reserved amount is within its limit.

name: personal_llm_sends_logged
flagged: ADR-0050 rule 5: local provider and personal data
statement: Every LLM step that sent personal values has its personal_data_processing_log entry; no LLM step sent a personal value while its company's routing switch was on.

name: agent_tool_lists_safe
statement: No agent type version's tool list holds a command of effect class posting, a Submit, Post or Issue command, a human_only, outbound_send or is_internal_only command, an allowed-target command of ADR-0029 rule 2 (effect class master_data_change or is_proposal_bound), an approval, taint clearing, auto-post confirmation, policy, role, agent-setting or promotion-evidence command, an agent run command or query, a work item claim, assign or resolve command, an audit query, ListAllowedCommand, GetSessionContext, GetPolicyEvaluation or CreateListExport.

name: tainted_reads_in_scope
flagged: ADR-0050 rule 27: reading of the literal read scope
source: ADR-0050 rule 27; spec 03 rule 1; ADR-0029 rule 14
statement: Every row reference in result_refs, context_refs and request_refs of a step recorded after its run's tainted_at, wherever the row was first read, is inside that run's tainted read scope: its scope rows, its work item and evidence, drafts of its work item and agent type, or reference data.

name: tainted_commands_draft_only
source: ADR-0050 rules 26, 55; ADR-0013 rule 11; ADR-0038 rule 2
statement: Every audit record of a command run by an agent run tainted at the record's recorded_at, or by a consumer whose origin run was tainted at the origin event's recorded_at (the instant INV-210 uses), has is_draft_only true as registered at the time, except CompleteAgentRun.

name: role_permissions_match_levels
statement: Every role's role_permission rows equal the expansion of its role_level rows under the current registry minus the role's holds in force (held or ignored), and expansion_hash is the SHA-256 of the sorted stored list.

name: owner_scope_consistent
statement: Every user assignment with owner scope branch has a record scope and every one with company has none; the edit scope is not wider than the read scope; no other assignment has an owner scope.

name: delegated_commands_inside_window
statement: Every command audited with delegated_from_user_id lies inside a delegation in force on that day from that user to the human actor, of a kind that covers the command.

name: small_company_mode_bounded
flagged: ADR-0054 rule 20: small-company mode
statement: While permissions.small_company_mode is on, at most two active users hold a posting or approval permission, and every segregation_exception was recorded while the mode was on.

name: approvers_distinct_per_round
statement: Within one approval round no human appears in two counted approvals, as approver or as delegator.

name: approver_not_writer
flagged: ADR-0055 rule 7: writers excluded
statement: No counted approval's approver or delegator wrote a version of the document, acted as on_behalf_of of one, or was the human of its origin agent run, unless a segregation_exception records it under the small-company mode; the agent-run part has no exception.

name: stage_approvals_in_sequence
statement: Every approval row's stage was current when it was decided: every earlier stage of the decision's plan had its required approvals in the round before it.

name: credential_commands_guarded
statement: Every name or e-mail change, credential reset and lockout clearance of a user account was executed by an operator, or by a company caller when the user was linked to that company and to no other on that day; every name or e-mail change and reset by a company caller was made by one who held every permission the user held in the company; no consumed reset changed is_totp_enabled; every session of the user created before a consumed reset is revoked; no reset token issued by a company was used after its user became shared.

name: employee_organization_by_own_command
statement: Every recorded change of employee_profile.department_id, manager_partner_id or user_account_id belongs to an UpdateEmployeeOrganization audit record.

name: no_conflict_in_block_mode
statement: While permissions.segregation_assignment_mode is block, no user's permissions in force on any day, from assignments and delegations other than assignments of the owner template, hold both sides of an enabled segregation rule.

name: ranked_decision_has_plan
statement: Every policy decision with a required rank has a non-empty approval_plan.

name: invitation_confirmed_before_access
statement: No role assignment naming a user_invitation was in force before that invitation was confirmed by its own user, unless the invitation created a new account; none naming a pending, canceled or expired invitation is in force; every user assignment that was its user's first link to a company names a confirmed invitation, except the bootstrap owner's.

name: tax_lines_tie_to_journal
statement: Per journal entry and tax code, the tax_line rows sum to the journal tax line in document and company currency: the line posted through the code's transaction key (import_tax for import VAT), or through input_tax_non_deductible for rows with input_use non_taxable.

name: tax_lines_equal_document_taxes
statement: The tax_line rows of a posted document equal the document_line_tax rows of its posted version in code, base, rate and tax.

name: counterpart_pairs_exact
statement: For every journal entry, the counterpart pairs sum exactly to each line's company amount, and each pair is its exact share rounded down or up to the minor unit.

name: report_drill_down_equals_figure
statement: Every statement figure computed from account terms equals the sum of the contributions its drill-down lists.

name: book_balances_tie_to_accounts
statement: Each book group's opening and closing balance equals the balance of its accounts (by partner or item where grouped) on those dates, opening plus rows equals closing, and the stock valuation book's total equals the inventory accounts.

name: statement_checks_hold
flagged: ADR-0049 rule 9: check lines and coverage are package data
statement: For each regular period of the run locked in general, and for each fiscal year of the run whose regular periods are all locked in general, over the range from its first to its last day: every check line of every package statement in force on the last day is zero, and no account is reported as not covered.

name: final_subject_render_unique
statement: For subjects in a final state, no two render jobs in state pending or done share a render key, and every generated file linked to a posted document was rendered from its posted version.

name: analysis_cell_equals_drill_rows
statement: Every drillable analysis cell equals its drill rows by the table of ADR-0060 rule 16: the sum of their contributions for sums, counts, differences, totals, subtotals and contribution rows, the number of distinct keys for distinct counts, and the opening row plus the lines for balances, at the same snapshot.

name: management_turnover_equals_report_turnover
statement: For full scope, every range and every system account subtree, each ledger analysis measure equals ADR-0049 rule 6's turnover measure over the operational accounts mapped to that subtree for the same range and special_periods option (change, debit_turnover or credit_turnover), with closing_entries=exclude for the profit-and-loss measures and migration entries left out, in every regime.

name: analysis_totals_from_rows
statement: Every total, subtotal and other row of an analysis result equals the aggregation of its fact rows, never a sum of non-additive cells; no total row adds values of different currencies or inventory units; every contribution result's reconciliation row is zero.

name: analysis_sentences_rendered_by_code
statement: Every user-visible sentence of an analysis answer is rendered by code, from a key-fact template or from a claim template whose precondition held on the served cells; every stored narrative plan holds only claim codes, roles and handles.

name: analysis_verified_badge_by_hash
statement: Every analysis answer recorded with badge verified has an analysis_plan_hash equal, after removing filters on open dimensions, to a saved analysis version or analysis example that was verified at its recorded_at.

name: automatic_match_authenticated
statement: No interaction with match_method reply, contact_email or domain has an inbound message whose is_sender_authenticated is false, or whose mailbox was not authentication-verified when it was recorded.

name: open_complaint_flag_matches
statement: When cash's complaint consumer has no pending, running or held delivery, partner_collection.has_open_complaint is true exactly for the partners with an open complaint.

name: sent_messages_had_consent
statement: Every delivery attempt of an outbound message whose type's purpose needs consent had, for each delivery recipient, a consent basis started at or before requested_at and not ended before it.

name: follow_up_has_work_item
statement: Every task interaction has exactly one follow_up_due work item; it is open or claimed only while no later task corrects it and the task is not erased.

name: erased_rows_blank
statement: Every crm row with erased_at has its erasure columns empty: interaction subject, content body, participant address and name, inbound message raw fields and sender authentication, complaint title and note, outbound message content and its content_salt, delivery recipient address and failure reason, request requester data, outcome note and content_salt (the identity-proof hash stays), personal domain; and no erasure changed a header or version of a document in a final state.

name: outbound_closed_iff_sent
statement: An outbound message is closed exactly when one of its delivery attempts has outcome sent; a message in sending has exactly one attempt without an outcome, and a message in any other state has none.

name: line_unit_snapshot_consistent
statement: Every quantity line carries its unit block; its snapshot equals convert_quantity for its item and unit when the unit was set (the item row, the product row or the global pair then in force), or its source line's snapshot for a line in the source's unit; its inventory quantity is round_quantity(quantity x factor) in the line's mode, or the cumulative value of INV-601.

name: cumulative_parts_sum
statement: For every posted source line (for invoices, the order line), each forward part in its unit posted round((C + q) × f) − P at its snapshot, positive and clamped to between q × f − 1 and q × f + 1 inventory units (a value of zero or less is rejected), with C and P the actual net sums of the earlier posted parts in that unit; each return, credit or reversal of a part in the part's unit mirrors the part or takes its cumulative share of the part's stored inventory quantity, never exceeding it; a money-side return naming a stock return line in its unit and entered quantity posted that line's inventory quantity; T(S) grew only by rounded parts in other units and by the changes returns, credits, reversals and clamps made to the deviation; and when C reaches the source's entered quantity, P is within T(S) of its inventory quantity, and equal to it when T(S) is zero.

name: stock_only_in_inventory_unit
statement: Every material document line's quantity equals its source document line's inventory quantity, and every stock, reservation, demand, supply and planned quantity is at its item's inventory unit decimals.

name: line_factor_in_force
statement: Every line whose snapshot source is item or product carries the factor of the row in force for its item and unit when its snapshot was taken, at the level it names (an item row before the product row; a level with rows but none in force uncovers nothing; a row is in force from recorded_at until retired_at), unless it is a follow-on line keeping its source line's snapshot; no line, price entry, supplier item or product default names a retired company unit or global conversion after its retirement, with the same exemption.

name: serial_units_exact
statement: Every unit a serial-tracked product resolves (its product and item rows and catalog units) is exact, and every line of such a product has an exact snapshot.

name: product_units_classified
statement: Every product unit's is_exact equals numerator x 10^dI divisible by denominator x 10^dE; a row names a catalog-convertible unit only with factor_source catalog and the catalog's factor; at most one row per product, item and unit is active; and every packaging row's factor equals contains_quantity times its contained unit's factor.

name: barcode_registry_complete
statement: Every barcode held by item_barcode, bin, handling_unit, lot and serial_number, and every number of a numbered is_barcoded document, has exactly one registry row of its type with its normalized value and its owner's legacy flag; every registry row of those types has exactly one owner row; every other row has type internal, and a retired one names its type and owner.

name: gs1_keys_valid
statement: Every GTIN in the registry has 14 digits and every SSCC 18, each with a valid GS1 check digit; no two registry codes of 1 to 14 digits are equal once padded to 14; and the unit of every item_barcode is the inventory unit or a product unit of its item.

name: internal_and_label_codes
statement: Every internal code in the registry is one upper-case letter followed by at most 47 of A-Z 0-9 - . / _, and every legacy code 1 to 48 of them starting with a letter or digit; every lot or serial whose code is not 1 to 20 characters of GS1 character set 82 has its own internal barcode.

name: document_barcode_formats
statement: No reserved prefix of a barcoded document type starts another's, no registry row of another type starts with one, and every number a barcoded type's format can produce with the company's current branch and fiscal year codes is an internal code of at most 48 characters.

name: gs1_prefixes_disjoint
statement: No two GS1 company prefixes of a company overlap (none starts another); at most one is the generation prefix, and it is active; no registry GTIN or SSCC under one of the company's prefixes outlives that prefix's row.

name: extraction_rows_append_only
statement: No extraction field, rule run or confirmation row changed after insert except by erasure; every rule run was written in the transaction of a recording, vision write or correction; every superseding field row has the same extraction, field path and value type as the row it supersedes, is a human row or a machine row replacing a row not found or illegible, and supersedes a row no other row supersedes; each path has one root row.

name: vision_values_from_reader_runs
statement: Every vision_aligned and vision_unaligned row names a run of the agent type document_reader, every vision_aligned row's words are consecutive on one line, and no vision_unaligned row has a confirmation.

name: served_trust_holds
statement: For every extraction field in an agent run step's context_refs, the stored served trust equals the trust recomputed from the rows up to the stored rule run number, and a step that received a field served untrusted, or its raw text or evidence, belongs to a run tainted at or before that step.

name: extraction_label_not_lower
statement: Every extraction's and field's data label is at least its attachment's.

name: verified_extraction_complete
statement: Every extraction in state verified has a current confirmed row for every required field of its purpose, and for every field when a full review is required; every result of its latest rule run before the verification passed, or is named in rule_overrides with a reason and is not shape.

name: vision_only_with_permission
statement: Every LLM request of any run mode that carried an attachment page was covered at its recorded_at by an active data-processing permission for its company, data class, seat class, provider and registered region, with the company's routing switch off.

name: e_invoice_key_among_unquarantined
statement: Two incoming e-invoice records that are not quarantined share a supplier-invoice key only when the later has a passed signature and names the earlier in key_conflict_with_record_id; a record with superseded_by_record_id is quarantined and names a record with a passed signature and the same key.

name: released_structure_items_bound
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: No released bill of materials revision has a component or a main output without its item (or configurable product), or with a proposal-item reference.

name: released_routing_durations_stated
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: No released routing revision has an operation with is_setup_duration_stated or is_run_duration_stated false.

name: released_estimate_complete
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: No released cost estimate has a gap row or lacks a production version.

name: proposal_references_creating
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Every proposal-item reference names a CreateProduct or CreateItem item of a change proposal of the same company, and no reference remains once that proposal's execution has been delivered to the binding consumer, except a line whose unit had no factor, which a note names.

name: release_approver_not_requester
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Every executed release proposal drafted by a product_engineering run was approved by a person other than the human the run acted for.

name: drafted_values_from_sources
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Every quantity, time and code on a draft revision written by a product_engineering run equals a value of a source span recorded in its run's steps, or of an extraction field its evidence links name.

name: automation_actions_registered
statement: Every audit record with an automation_rule_version_id names a command registered is_automation_allowed at the time, StartAgentRun or a registered hold command, and ran as system on behalf of the rule's owner at that time, except the agent run a StartAgentRun started, which acts for the agent setting's workflow owner.

name: causation_depth_bounded
statement: Every outbox event and audit record has causation_depth between 0 and 3, and at least 1 where it names a rule version; every audit record with an automation_rule_version_id has its triggering event's chain and that event's depth plus one; every consumer command, and every tool call of an agent run started from an event, has that event's chain and depth.

name: automation_once_per_chain_target
statement: No two live executions with outcome acted or partial share rule, causation chain and subject, and no rule version has two executions of one event in one mode.

name: automation_owner_permitted
statement: Every action recorded done in a live execution ran while the rule's owner held in the company on that business date the action's permission: the command's own for create_draft and set_hold, the subject's Get or List permission with record and owner scope for raise_work_item and notify, start_agent:<agent_type> for start_agent; evaluated from the audit record and the owner's assignments in force.

name: automation_taint_inherited
statement: Every action of an execution whose event or subject was tainted is an is_draft_only command, RaiseAutomationWorkItem, or StartAgentRun of an agent type that accepts the subject table, and wrote tainted rows; no StartAgentRun with an automation_rule_version_id follows an event that carries an origin agent run, and no set_hold follows a tainted event or subject.

name: automation_graph_bounded
statement: No current, shadow or disabled automation rule version, with the others, forms a cycle in the rule graph or acts beyond depth 3 under the registry in force.

name: decision_tables_order_free
statement: Every unique decision table version out of draft has no two rows whose boxes intersect, every monotone one uses only commutative, associative and idempotent aggregators, every rule version that uses a table version states its handling of decision_no_match, and every table version a current or shadow rule version pins is assisted or active.

name: artifact_versions_immutable
statement: Every artifact version out of draft has the content its content_hash names, and its child rows have not changed since it left draft.

name: artifact_pointers_eligible
statement: Every current pointer names a version of its artifact in state assisted or active (automation rules: active), and every shadow pointer a version in shadow.

name: artifact_promotions_evidenced
statement: Every promoted transition names sufficient evidence of the same version whose content hash, engine version and baseline equalled the version's at execution, from an approved change proposal whose approver was neither its submitter nor the version's drafter nor the human its drafting run acted for.

name: backtests_out_of_sample
statement: Every backtest evidence's evaluation window starts after its version's drafting window; no sufficient evidence has fewer cases than its minimum, a held-out case among its drafting run's recorded reads mapped through the case-reference columns (checked against drafting_reads_hash and, while retained, the steps), or a read dated after the drafting window; no drafting agent type version's tool list holds a query that is not held-out filtered.

name: parameters_within_bounds
statement: Every parameter value lies within the bounds and order constraints its function declared at the version's function version, and no safety cap is null or exceeds its core default.

name: auto_post_parameters_evidenced
statement: Every bank document posted by system from a cascade proposal has a line that carries the parameters hash its auto-post rule's enabling evidence names, match_parameter_state active or core_default, match_is_tied false and no counterparty_unverified or paid_by_third_party flag, and that rule version's shadow_evidence_outdated_by is null; every demotion, rollback, invalidation or failed re-evaluation of the parameter set set it on every dependent rule version in its own transaction.

name: gates_read_gate_fields
statement: No condition field, decision table input or scorer gate reads a field that is not registered is_gate_field, and no gate field has LLM lineage.

name: breaches_demote
statement: Every monitor snapshot that breached its threshold has the demotion transition it caused, and no demoted version is in force again without later evidence.

name: golden_labels_by_approvers
statement: Every golden case label was recorded by a user who held the approve flag on its function's leaf that day, and its is_held_out equals the deterministic assignment (a database check).

name: automation_owner_scope
statement: Every live execution's subject was inside its owner's record and owner scope on that business date, and the owner held the field class of every condition field and action value of the version then; no stored condition value is a plain hash of a personal value, and every out-of-scope subject is in the rule's daily count.

name: automation_draft_writers
statement: No approval of a draft that an automation rule made was given by the rule's owner, the version's drafter or the human its drafting run acted for, or the triggering event's human.

name: settings_registered
statement: Every setting_value names a registered key at a scope its definition declares, its type, bounds, allowed values and direction equal its definition's, its value lies within them, and its change_kind is the one its direction and replaced value give (database checks and the insert trigger).

name: setting_loosening_approved
statement: Every setting_value with change_kind loosen names an executed, approved change proposal whose approver is neither its submitter nor a writer of it.

name: setting_effective_dates
statement: No setting_value takes effect before the business date it was recorded on, and every value of a period_start key takes effect on the first day of a posting period.

name: setting_loosening_outdates_evidence
statement: Every loosening of a key with outdates auto_post marked the evidence of every dependent enabled auto-post rule version of the company outdated in its own transaction.

name: auto_post_error_ceiling
statement: Every enabled auto-post rule version of a learned or probabilistic matching path has evidence of N proposals, N >= 3 / rate, at least (1 - rate) posted unchanged, for the auto_post.max_error_rate in force at enabling, and that rate is at most 2%.

name: bank_charge_auto_post_gated
statement: Every document posted by system from a bank_charge rule has a debit line whose bank transaction code its money account lists, no counterparty account, no open item matched, one matching rule, and an amount at most the rule's amount_max, itself at most the company ceiling on the posting date.

name: llm_originated_rules_gated
statement: No document posted by system has match basis llm_suggestion, and none comes from a rule version of origin llm_proposed unless cash.auto_post.accept_llm_originated_rules was true on that date and the conditions of rule 8 held.

name: wrong_auto_post_suspends
statement: Every reversal of a system posting, and every confirmation recording one wrong, marked its rule version's evidence outdated in the same transaction.

name: personal_values_permitted
statement: Every model call that carried a personal value had an active, unsuspended permission covering its data class, seat class, provider and region, carried no field listed in data_processing.never_send_fields, and was logged before it was sent.

name: data_processing_terms_current
statement: Every active, unsuspended permission's provider terms reference, region and retention equal the provider registry's, and no permitted endpoint trains on customer data.

name: tainted_projection_columns
flagged: ADR-0063 rule 16: declared projections as a reading of spec 03 rule 1
statement: Every response a tainted run received from a declared projection held only the projection's columns, at most 20 rows, and within the run's call cap.

name: wake_up_mode_respected
statement: No agent_wake_up start happened for a kind whose company wake-up mode was by_rule or off on that business date.

name: automation_flood_guard
statement: No rule has more live executions other than rate_limited in a clock hour than its hourly limit in force, and no rate_limited execution ran an action or counted toward the breaker.

name: extension_points_bounded
statement: Every extension point's ceilings lie within the core maxima, its decision kind is not an approval, posting, rights or settings decision (a database check), and no extension ran while extensions.wasm_enabled was false.

name: product_codes_stable
statement: Product codes are unique per company, never reused after deletion, and unchanged once any document refers to them.

name: purchase_return_option_stamped
statement: Every purchase return movement records the value source, costing role and landed-cost choice in force on its posting date, and those options change only at period starts.

name: narrative_mode_bounded
statement: No analysis answer was rendered in a narrative mode looser than the installation maximum or the company's value on that date, and none as free_prose in Phase 1.

name: barcode_policy_stamped
statement: Every parse result records the day 00, unknown-AI and separator values it used, and no lot's expiry date was filled from (15) while barcode.gs1.best_before_fills_expiry read false for its category.

name: duplicate_review_holds_payment
statement: Every purchase invoice ran the exact duplicate key on its channel, and every posted one suspected at level 3 under outcome review had its open item blocked for payment until the review was resolved.

name: production_agent_tool_lists
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: No tool list of a production, production_capture or production_variance agent type version holds a posting command, a Submit, Post, Approve, Issue or Send command, StartAgentRun, TransferStockReservation, CompleteProductionOrder, ReopenProductionOrder, ImportOperationConfirmation or a planned-order command.

name: capture_runs_scoped
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Every production_capture run was tainted from its start, has scope kind subject on a production order, and every row reference in its steps is that order or its lines, its work item and evidence, its own drafts or reference data.

name: capture_drafts_posted_by_people
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Every posted production issue, operation confirmation or production receipt whose version a production_capture run wrote was posted by a human.

name: capture_quantities_as_stated
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Every quantity, lot and posting date on a draft written by a production_capture run equals the normalized value of an extraction field named in its evidence.

name: reservation_transfers_by_proposal
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Every reservation with transferred_from_reservation_id has the company, item, warehouse and lot of its source, was created by a TransferStockReservation executed from an approved change proposal, in the transaction that reduced its source by the same quantity, and did not take the target line above its open requirement; no reservation command of a production agent run reduced another demand line's reservation.

name: component_reservations_within_requirement
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Per production order component line, open and picked reservations never exceed the open requirement.

name: shortage_policy_input_matches_check
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Every has_component_shortage policy input recorded at Submit of a production order equals whether EvaluateProductionOrderRelease returned component_short for that version on that business date.

name: production_exceptions_closed_by_runs
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Every closed production_order_exception, production_component_shortage, production_completion_candidate, production_order_stalled and production_standard_review work item, and every closed planning_exception of the production kinds, was closed by a planning run or RunProductionOrderCheck, never by an agent run.

name: production_exceptions_on_live_orders
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Every planning_exception of kind production_order_start_overdue or production_order_overdue names an order that was approved and not technically complete on the run's planning date, and whose date plus the grace setting was before that date.

name: variance_drivers_sum
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: For every settled order, period and variance category, the contributions of ListProductionOrderVarianceDriver sum to the category's row of production_order_variance.

name: import_postings_gated
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: Every operation confirmation posted by an integration actor has entry_source production_import and an external_reference, was posted while production.mes_import.auto_post was true under a policy rule enabled with evidence that met the import evidence settings in force, by a credential holding post on operation_confirmation, and had no check result in its plan at posting.

name: scheduled_reservations_within_window
flagged: ADR-0032 rule 7: production core step (number pending author)
statement: In reservation mode scheduled, no reservation made by a release or a sweep is for a component line whose requested date lay beyond the window on that business date.
